characters.name: Taylor Armstrong
characters.description: Divorce Requires Death: Taylor and Russell were pursuing a divorce but he ended taking his own life, resulting in Taylor becoming his widow. The other women can be seen reacting to it Domestic Abuse: Camille reveals that Taylor had been going through with Russell. The Rival: To Kim in the first season. They do not mix well at all.

characters.name: Camille Grammer
characters.description: 0% Approval Rating: Camille was voted the most hated Housewife in America after Season 1. This prompts her to turn the public perception of her around in Season 2. Berserk Button: “Don’t be so insecure”— Kyle. Catchphrase:"So pernicious."Camille credits her college education as an English major for her word choice. The Cat Came Back: Camille exited the series as a full-time Housewife after Season 2, but aside from Kyle and LVP, she is the most frequently seen of the OGs. Happy Marriage Charade: Camille tried for the cameras, but alas her marriage to Kelsey didn't survive.

characters.name: Kim Richards
characters.description: Alone Among the Couples: In Season 1. At the time, Kim was the only cast member who was unmarried and felt a bit insecure about it. Big "SHUT UP!": "Kyle, shush up!" during the dinner scene in Amsterdam. Foolish Sibling, Responsible Sibling: According to Kyle, Kim is the Foolish to her Responsible. Former Child Star: She was a very successful child actress. She is best known for her roles inNanny and the Professor,Escape to Witch Mountain, andReturn from Witch Mountain.Her Season 1 tagline refers to her fame in her juvenile years:"I was a child star, but now my most important role is being a mother." Sibling Rivalry: With her younger sister, Kyle.Kim and Kathy have a much more peaceful relationship with each other. Emphasized in "Amster-damn!" (Season 5, Episode 16) when Kim tells Kyle:"Kathy would have my back, like a real sister!"

characters.name: Kyle Richards
characters.description: Foolish Sibling, Responsible Sibling: According to Kyle, she is the Responsible to Kim's Foolish. Former Child Star: Albeit to a lesser degree than her sister. Happily Married: To husband Mauricio Umansky. Last of Her Kind: As of Season 10, Kyle is the last remaining originalRHOBHcast member. Mama's Girl: Kyle often shares memories of her deceased mother, "Big Kathy" Richards.

characters.name: Lisa Vanderpump
characters.description: Fan Nickname: "LVP." Helps to distinguish her from Lisa Rinna after Season 4. Foil: To Kyle. During the seasons where the two of them were having issues, they would often be leading the squads against each other. Greek Chorus: Lisa is this during the first season of the show. She doesn't have too much going on for herself but she always provided excellent commentary on everything going on around her. Narrator: Lisa functions as this in the debut season of the show. Spin-Off:Vanderpump RulesandVanderpump Dogs.
